annotation_method: Passage review against the locally stored official guideline PDFs. These page-level labels are suitable for engineering evaluation but require independent clinician adjudication before clinical or publication claims.

q03.rationale: NG136 recommendation 1.4.5 directly addresses dietary sodium.

q04.rationale: NG28 section 1.5 contains HbA1c measurement and individualized targets.
